meta.name: escalation-management
meta.description: Handles customer situations that have exceeded normal support — severity assessment, incident communication, executive escalation, and recovering a relationship after a failure. Use this when a customer issue is escalating or has gone to leadership, during a customer-affecting outage, when a major account is at risk, when a relationship needs repairing after a failure, or to design the escalation path itself.

copy.tagline: 让客户升级得到专业处置与关系修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要处理客户升级或修复重要客户关系
copy.tagline_en: Resolve serious customer issues and mend relationships
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage escalated customer issues and need to rebuild trust

howto.what: Claude 会按此技能处理客户升级:从客户角度看事情严重程度,指定唯一负责人并定时通报进展,先承认影响再解释原因,不随口承诺;高管介入前备好简报,故障后帮客户恢复信任并做复盘。
howto.when: 当客户问题升级或已上报领导、发生影响客户的中断、重要账户面临风险等场景时触发。

say.text: 客户问题升级了,说要找我们领导,帮我评估严重性并给出处理思路。
我们服务正在中断,客户业务受损,请给我一套定时沟通模板。
say.note: Claude 会生成先确认影响、再按节奏更新的沟通话术。

say.text: 客户对我们失望了,想重归于好,我该怎么具体道歉和提供保证?
say.note: Claude 会指导你按恢复流程承认具体失败并说明预防措施。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the escalation playbook: customer-side severity assessment, a named owner, regular updates, acknowledgment before explanation, no overpromising, exec briefs, relationship recovery, and a review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a customer issue is escalating or has reached leadership, during a customer-affecting outage, or when a major account is at risk, etc.

say_en.text: Customer escalated to leadership. Assess severity and outline how to handle it.
say_en.note: Claude assesses severity and outlines actions with owner.

say_en.text: Our service is down and customers are affected. Give a staged communication plan.
say_en.note: Claude drafts updates acknowledging impact first, on cadence.

say_en.text: Customer is upset. How should we apologize specifically and show the fix?
say_en.note: Claude guides acknowledgment and demonstrable change.
